Add vocabulary norm percentiles to CDI scores

Source: R/cdi_processing.R
add_cdi_percentiles.Rd

Looks up where each raw score falls in the vocabulary norms for its language, instrument, measure and age in months (rounded to the nearest month). The norms cover English (American):

  • WG and WG short form, comprehension and production, 8 to 18 months

  • WS and WS short form, production, 16 to 30 months

Usage

add_cdi_percentiles(cdi)

Arguments

cdi

CDI scores, one per row, e.g. from unnest_aux(pb$subjects, "cdi_responses"). Needs language, instrument_type, measure, age and rawscore; sex is used if present.

Value

cdi with three columns added:

  • norm_age: the age in months whose norms were used

  • norm_percentile: the highest norm percentile (5, 10, ..., 95, 99) the score reaches, or 1 below the 5th

  • norm_percentile_sex: the same against children of the same sex, NA for sexes other than female and male

All three are NA for forms without norms and for ages outside the range the norms cover.

Details

WG and WS use the 2022 Wordbank norms, the short forms the MB-CDI short-form norms: Level I for WG short and Level IIA for WS short.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pb <- peekbank("2026.1")
cdi <- unnest_aux(pb$subjects, "cdi_responses") |>
  add_cdi_percentiles()
} # }
